newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom to raise fees for tv cable network.
newsitem.headline: Telekom to raise fees for tv cable network.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG said it planned to increase the fees it charges television companies for use of its cable network and will meet representatives of its main customers in Bonn on Tuesday.

Telekom Chief Executive Ron Sommer said in a television interview on Sunday that the group wants to increase earnings in its cable business and that both private and public channels will be affected by the price increases.
Tuesday's meeting will be attended by representatives from media groups Bertelsmann AG and Leo Kirch as well as regional public television organisations.
Sommer also said Telekom did not plan to become a programme provider in the digital television market of the future.
"We are not a provider and we don't want to be a provider that enters into competition with its customers," Sommer said.
After the broad introduction of digital television technology there will "not be just 150 channels, there will be 500 or 1,000 channels," Sommer said.
The content must be created in Germany rather than coming from Hollywood, he added.
